title: Mobile documentation website is currently unusable
body:
I tried to show the instantsearch website at lunch but on mobile it was not unusable.

What can we do for the 1.0.0 release that is not too hard to do but still gives the right experience on mobile?

People WILL access our documentation on mobile, especially at launch when it's all new.

comments.body: I was waiting the total end of our iterations do work on it, I'm pretty confident about it.
I had a look at the stripe doc and what they do. I will have a try on it.
